behaviors.description: Calculate unused dependencies under hypothetical app state.
behaviors.preconditions: App and its automatically installed unpinned runtime, with no initially unused refs.
behaviors.expected: Excluding the app or injecting an absent runtime/SDK makes exactly the original runtime unused; actual app metadata and both commits remain unchanged; subsequent ordinary query is empty.

behaviors.description: Enumerate remotely available and downloaded undeployed updates.
behaviors.preconditions: App A and runtime current, then remote B, then B downloaded without deployment, then B deployed.
behaviors.expected: Exact empty/app/app/empty sets; unchanged runtime excluded throughout.

behaviors.description: Enumerate installed membership and kind filters.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent query repository; initially empty, then runtime only, then three app builds.
behaviors.expected: Exact unordered installed sets and both empty-kind cases; advertised undeployed refs excluded.

behaviors.description: Select default and current app branches.
behaviors.preconditions: Direct installation of master followed by test, with runtime already installed.
behaviors.expected: NULL components select master; current app is the last directly installed test commit and reports current TRUE.

behaviors.description: Retain an installed ref after its installation is released.
behaviors.preconditions: Actual deployed fixture queried through a separate installation object.
behaviors.expected: Retained ref identity and commit remain equal to the fixture after source destruction.

behaviors.description: Update enumeration for missing and changed shared dependencies.
preconditions: Two apps with missing runtime or related extension, or independent runtime/extension update
expected: Every affected app appears for each condition; complete current and repaired installations have no updates.

behaviors.description: Enumerate typed unused and pinned refs with architecture filters.
behaviors.preconditions: App using runtime/SDK and an unpinned extension; separate unused runtime; native and foreign pinned runtimes.
behaviors.expected: Exact unused and pinned membership for unrestricted, native, foreign and absent architectures; every returned element is an installed ref.

mappings.rationale: exclude-refs and metadata injection independently produce exact dependency changes without modifying deployed app/runtime identity or app metadata.
Four states assert exact update membership including downloaded undeployed B and exclusion of current dependency-complete refs.
Exact unordered sets across empty, runtime-only and multi-app states exclude undeployed available refs.
Direct installs select distinct branches; default lookup commit and last-installed current identity/flag asserted.
Fresh source installation released before independently owned returned ref identity/commit assertions.

Separate absent-runtime, absent-related, shared-runtime-update and shared-extension-update installations require both apps in public update enumeration. Exact prepared state and empty complete/repaired controls prevent vacuous matches.
Typed results exclude the app, its used runtime/SDK and unpinned related extension; include only the separate unused runtime; pinned native/foreign refs and all architecture filters checked exactly.
